melodicFingerprints: Hook E–G–A–Bb, bars 1–2 and 5–6, then the descent A–G–E–D at bars 3 and 7.
Bars 21–24 hold E against Bb. Bars 25–28 repeat A–G–E–D.
protectedLandmarks: Bar 8 is 3/4. Every other bar is 4/4.
Printed words: Crooked, dry, physical; Bass leads — guitar follows; OPEN DUO; wrong turn — let it stand.
Guitar rest at bar 30. No rehearsal marks. No chord symbols.
blueprint.originalBassIdentity: Bass moves from bar 1 (E–A–G) and does not wait for the guitar. Guitar octave-change is 0, so written guitar pitch is sounding pitch. CBV is no-change.
strongestPassages: No listening rank. The leadsheet’s own interruptions are the short bar 8, the four-bar E/Bb hold at 21–24, and the guitar rest at 30 before Bb–E–A.
A–H are inventoried, including E-V3.0. E V2.0 is not the E source.
blueprint.harmonicJourney: No chord symbols are printed. The bass line is the harmonic evidence: E/A/Bb motion, an F centre around bars 8–12 and 21–24, and F at the end.
blueprint.contrapuntalOpportunities: The score already says the bass leads and the guitar follows. Bars 4 and 20 put a lower guitar dyad under the hook. A second independent line is not written through the tune.
blueprint.dramaticClimax: Not auditioned. The printed instruction at the close is to let the wrong turn stand, not to build a peak.
blueprint.thematicReturn: Bars 25–28 bring back A–G–E–D. Bar 32 ends on E against Bb.
blueprint.expectedPerformanceDuration: Quarter = 120, and sound tempo 120. 31 bars of 4/4 plus bar 8 in 3/4 = 1:03.50.

motif.name: hook

narrative.name: Hook

narrative.job: Bar 8 is 3/4. Bass keeps moving. Guitar sits on A and A/Bb.

narrative.name: Hook again
narrative.job: Hook returns in shorter pieces. Bar 16 is the bass’s longest bar.

narrative.name: Descent and stop
narrative.job: A–G–E–D four times, guitar rest at 30, then the last E/Bb. Printed words: let the wrong turn stand.

seams.job: Rest, then the last two bars

mci.continuity: The E–G–A–Bb hook and the A–G–E–D descent stay recognisable. Bar 8 stays in 3/4. The bass event stream stays.
mci.innovation: A performance score may cut an expectation after the hook or across the E/Bb hold. It does not smooth the short bar into 4/4, and it does not borrow The Mirror’s section letters.
